module.Chapter: Chapter 5 · Functions, Files, and Raspberry Pi
module.Title: Log Sensor Readings
module.Teaching: with open(..., 'a') opens a file safely in append mode, preserving existing log entries.
module.ExampleCode:
with open("events.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("Pump started\n")
PredictionOptions: To add new entries without erasing earlier ones
To convert text to a float
module.PredictionExplanation: Append mode writes at the end of the existing file.
module.DebugPrompt: Use a with statement, open(), append mode, indentation, and file.write().
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the temperature logging block. Use these exact identifiers: file, open, write. Use these exact values: 21.5, "Temperature: 21.5\n", "readings.txt".
module.TransferPrompt: Append Pump 1 started to events.txt. Use these exact identifiers: file, open, write. Use the exact value "Pump 1 started\n".
module.TransferCode:
with open("events.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("Pump 1 started\n")
module.PreviewMessage: The facility can now preserve a history of readings.
